units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 4:1:9">Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 54ᵈ</cite> <he>כ׳ שהוא מוכר</he> according to the selling price.
<cite ref="Shabbat 51a:8">Sabb. 51ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כ׳ שהוא</he> (<cite ref="H00648"><he>חי</he></cite>) in its natural condition (raw).
Keth. 17ᵃ כלה כ׳ שהיא the bride at weddings must be praised according to her perfections (without exaggeration); a. fr.—With suffixes: כְּמוֹתִי, כְּמוֹתְךָ &c. like myself, like thyself &c.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 59b:2">B. Mets. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>אם הלכה כ׳</he> if the law is in accordance with my opinion, v. <cite ref="K00412"><he>כְּוָת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 1:1:14">Y. Ned. I, 36ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>כ׳ ירבו וכ׳</he> may there be many like thee &c.; (Bab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:5">Ber. V, 5</cite>, a. fr. <he>שלוחו של אדם כְּמוֹתוֹ</he> a man’s messenger is like himself, i.e. action by proxy is legal; a. fr.
